lines.text: Every market runs on one number.
lines.caption: Every market runs on one number.

lines.text: Ours is what it costs to rent an H one hundred for an hour. Right now, about three dollars and seventy cents.
lines.caption: Ours is what it costs to rent an H100 for an hour. Right now, about $3.70.

lines.text: That number marks every position, triggers every liquidation, and settles every contract.
lines.caption: That number marks every position, triggers every liquidation, and settles every contract.

lines.text: So the real question is: who gets to write it?
lines.caption: So the real question is: who gets to write it?

lines.text: The simple answer is one key, on one server. Which works perfectly, right up until it doesn't.
lines.caption: The simple answer is one key, on one server. Which works perfectly, right up until it doesn't.

lines.text: So Ingot hands the job to Chainlink's Runtime Environment.
lines.caption: So Ingot hands the job to the Chainlink Runtime Environment.

lines.text: Every hour, a cron trigger wakes a workflow that runs across a decentralized oracle network.
lines.caption: Every hour, a cron trigger wakes a workflow that runs across a decentralized oracle network.

lines.text: Each node independently fetches live rental quotes, covering more than twenty G P U providers, through the H T T P capability.
lines.caption: Each node independently fetches live rental quotes, covering 20+ GPU providers, through the HTTP capability.

lines.text: Then it applies the index method: a median per provider, and a trimmed mean across them.
lines.caption: Then it applies the index method: a median per provider, and a trimmed mean across them.

lines.text: Now, say one node is fed bad data, and reports ninety-nine dollars.
lines.caption: Now, say one node is fed bad data, and reports $99.

lines.text: The network takes the median across nodes. That answer isn't averaged in. It's simply outvoted.
lines.caption: The network takes the median across nodes. That answer isn't averaged in. It's simply outvoted.

lines.text: The agreed price becomes one signed report.
lines.caption: The agreed price becomes one signed report.

lines.text: Chainlink's forwarder verifies the signatures, and delivers it to Ingot's receiver on Mohnad.
lines.caption: Chainlink's forwarder verifies the signatures, and delivers it to Ingot's receiver on Monad.

lines.text: The receiver checks the sender, and the workflow. Anyone else is politely turned away.
lines.caption: The receiver checks the sender, and the workflow. Anyone else is politely turned away.

lines.text: And a quorum still isn't a blank check. The index enforces a deviation band, a minimum interval, and a finality delay.
lines.caption: And a quorum still isn't a blank check. The index enforces a deviation band, a minimum interval, and a finality delay.

lines.text: From there, that one price marks your trades, settles each contract, and decides whether a hedged loan comes out whole.
lines.caption: From there, that one price marks your trades, settles each contract, and decides whether a hedged loan comes out whole.

lines.text: We ran the full workflow with the C R E command line: it compiled, fetched, agreed on three seventy-five, and ran the write to Mohnad testnet as a dry run.
lines.caption: We ran the full workflow with the CRE CLI: it compiled, fetched, agreed on $3.75, and ran the write to Monad testnet as a dry run.

lines.text: Next step: a live D O N.
lines.caption: Next step: a live DON.

lines.text: Ingot, on Chainlink. One price. No single key.
lines.caption: Ingot, on Chainlink. One price. No single key.
